//: Verification-only permission profile for Davinci agents. Grants exactly the commands agents need to prove their own work -- running tests, builds, lint, typecheck, and reading git/filesystem state. Deliberately excludes npm install, git commit, git push, and anything that deploys: agents do not need them to verify, and granting them widens the blast radius of a mistake. See README.md, 'Letting agents verify their own work', for how to apply this.
//shoot: The screenshot tool lives in the plugin directory, whose absolute path differs per installation, so it cannot be listed here. To let frontend-engineer see its own work, add: "Bash(node /absolute/path/to/davinci/scripts/shoot.mjs:*)". Without it the agent reports that visual verification was impossible rather than implying it looked.
//verification: Deliberately absent: node -e, node -p, and running an arbitrary script file. A builder is not bash-guarded by the write-scope hook (only read-only agents are), so this allowlist is the only thing standing between a builder and writing outside its scope through node fs. Granting node -e would remove the plugin's central safety property to save an agent one command. An assertion that needs real code belongs in a test run with node --test -- see "Proving something the allowlist will not run" in the delegation contract.
